metadata.calibration_protocol: Thresholds selected exclusively on Validation partition (N=56,961); evaluated once on untouched Test partition (N=56,962).

low_false_alarm.name: High Precision / Low False Alarm
low_false_alarm.description: Prioritizes minimal cardholder insult and friction. Suitable for automated blocking.

balanced.name: Balanced (Peak F1)
balanced.description: Harmonizes precision and recall by maximizing the F1-harmonic mean on validation data.

high_recall.name: High Recall / Maximum Interception
high_recall.description: Prioritizes fraud capture (target >= 70% recall). Suitable for step-up verification (2FA/SMS OTP).

low_fpr.name: Controlled Low FPR (FPR <= 0.25%)
low_fpr.description: Enforces a strict upper bound on false alarm rate (FPR <= 0.25%) to preserve customer experience.

cost_optimal.name: Minimum Business Cost (FP=1, FN=10)
cost_optimal.description: Minimizes illustrative cost function with 10:1 penalty ratio between missed fraud and false alarm.
